# Results — Study 71 (Ambush) on the real tape

*Generated by [`examples/verify.py`](../examples/verify.py). SPY split-only daily OHLC and ^VIX raw
closes, 1993 → as-of **2026-06-01**; per-day cash rate from ^IRX (bench convention). Protocol,
thresholds and verdict criteria frozen **before** this run in
[`preregistration.md`](preregistration.md) — nothing below was tuned to the outcome. The offline
core proves the machinery on a planted tape (`examples/run_synthetic_demo.py`); this is the
measurement on the market. Match the fingerprints to confirm you hold the same tape.*

## The verdict, earned — Signal `REAL` · Tradability `FRAGILE` · Rarity defeats costs? `CONFIRMED`

The confluence premium is **real and monotone**: a day when ≥3 of the four dead-net edges fire
together (IBS low, turn-of-month, red close, VIX stress) is followed by **+19.6 bp**
of next-day SPY return (HAC *t* = **+3.06**), against +0.55 bp on a
zero-signal day — and White's Reality Check across the whole announced K family puts the best net
book at **p = 0.009**. The premium has **not decayed** across 2015
(+17.6 → +15.3 bp/day, *t*-change +0.17) even though every
ingredient, traded alone, died years ago. The cost defence **worked as designed**: at ~15
round-trips/yr, spread + financing eat **0.40%/yr of a 1.63%/yr gross** (study 19's
daily IBS book lost >100% of its edge to the same toll). What keeps the stamp at `FRAGILE` is the
size of the prize, not the costs: in market only 7.6% of days under the 1%/day budget, the
book earns **+1.23%/yr excess** (net Sharpe **+0.42**, 95% CI
[+0.10, +0.73]) — but the OOS Sharpe of **+0.28** misses the
pre-registered 0.30 bar and its CI [-0.23, +0.79] spans zero. A real overlay,
honestly sized — not a fund.

## The lift is monotone (next-day raw SPY return by confluence count)

| count at close | next-day (bps) | n | share of days |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | +0.55 | 3392 | 40.4% |
| 1 | +1.91 | 2772 | 33.0% |
| 2 | +9.21 | 1590 | 19.0% |
| 3 | +17.18 | 574 | 6.8% |
| 4 | +42.19 | 62 | 0.7% |

| armed stream | mean (bps/day) | HAC *t* | n |
|---|---|---|---|
| K ≥ 2 | +12.2 | +4.66 | 2226 |
| K ≥ 3 | +19.6 | +3.06 | 636 |
| K ≥ 4 | +42.2 | +2.43 | 62 |

- Monotone in K: **True**. Decay across 2015: armed-day premium
  +17.6 → +15.3 bp/day (Welch *t* +2.07 pre, +1.32 post;
  *t*-change **+0.17** — no detectable decay).
- Reality Check over the announced family K ∈ {1,2,3,4} (stationary bootstrap, 2000 draws):
  best net Sharpe +0.42, **p = 0.009**.

## The book (CFD overlay: vol target · 1%/day budget · stop · 1 bp + financing)

Net excess-of-cash, raced excess-vs-excess against SPY buy-and-hold:

| book | Sharpe (full) | excess/yr | time in mkt | trades/yr | IS ≤ 2014 | OOS ≥ 2015 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| K ≥ 1 | +0.35 | +2.42% | 59.4% | 53 | +0.35 | +0.35 |
| K ≥ 2 | +0.41 | +2.00% | 26.5% | 44 | +0.41 | +0.41 |
| K ≥ 3 | +0.42 | +1.23% | 7.6% | 15 | +0.52 | +0.28 |
| K ≥ 4 | +0.28 | +0.23% | 0.7% | 2 | +0.52 | +0.01 |
| SPY B&H (excess) | +0.42 | +7.83% | 100% | 0 | — | +0.62 |

- K ≥ 3 full-sample net Sharpe **+0.42**, 95% block-bootstrap CI
  [+0.10, +0.73]; OOS **+0.28**, CI
  [-0.23, +0.79] — positive but uncertified.
- Cost anatomy (full sample): gross +1.63%/yr − financing 0.21% − spread
  0.19% = **net +1.23%/yr**.
- Risk discipline: median exposure 0.52× (max 1.65×), stop fires
  2.1×/yr, max drawdown **-8.9%**, worst single day
  -2.62% (a gap through the stop — the 1% budget holds *at the stop*, gaps can exceed it; stated, not hidden).

Break-even sits near **7 bp one-way** full-sample (~5 bp OOS) against the ~1 bp a liquid US500
CFD/futures actually costs — the rarity defence holds a wide moat. Signal `REAL`,
Tradability `FRAGILE`, Rarity defeats costs? `CONFIRMED`.
